definitions.explanation: An answer that is not correct. The formal opposite of {正解|せいかい} (correct answer). Used in tests, quizzes, and game shows.

examples.japanese: {不正解|ふせいかい}！もう{一度|いちど}。
{不正解|ふせいかい}が{三|みっ}つもあった。
クイズで{不正解|ふせいかい}だと{罰|ばつ}ゲームをさせられる。
examples.english: On the quiz show, if you get a wrong answer, you have to do a punishment game.

notes: Composed of {不|ふ} (non-, un-) + {正解|せいかい} (correct answer). The antonym {正解|せいかい} is more commonly used in everyday conversation. {不正解|ふせいかい} is especially common on TV quiz shows, in educational apps, and in formal test contexts. Note: distinct from {誤答|ごとう} (wrong answer — more formal, used in academic testing) and {間違|まちが}い (mistake — more casual).
